meta.title: About AZAFCO International | Egyptian Seafood-Led Group
meta.description: AZAFCO International is an Egyptian company led by fish farming, processing and export, with agriculture, livestock and investment activities.

hero.title: One international brand. Several production activities. One clear commercial focus.
hero.intro: AZAFCO International brings together a portfolio of production and investment activities, led by its core business: fish farming, processing, packing and export.

story.title: Seafood first, by design
story.p1: AZAFCO began in fish. Over successive stages of development and operation, its activities grew to serve buyers at home and abroad.
story.p2: Under the AZAFCO International identity, we present the company as what it is: a multi-activity Egyptian business led by deep specialisation in seafood, organised to work with international partners and importers.

architecture.title: How the group fits together
architecture.intro: One parent brand. Seafood at the core, with other productive activities alongside it.
architecture.core_text: Fish farming, processing, packing and export for commercial buyers. The focus of our supply offer and of this website.
architecture.agri_text: Farmland and fruit and vegetable production.
architecture.invest_text: Other investments, described once approved for publication.

footprint.title: Where the work happens
footprint.p1: Our fish processing and packing plant is in the Industrial Zone of Motobas, Kafr El Sheikh, in Egypt's Nile Delta.
footprint.p2: This is where fish is received, graded, prepared, packed and loaded for dispatch.

principles.title: We start with specifications, not slogans
principles.intro: Four commitments that shape how we deal with buyers.
principles.i1_text: We start from what you need (species, size, packing, quantity and target market), then confirm what can be delivered.
principles.i2_text: You get the information you need to decide, including what is still to be confirmed.
principles.i3_text: Hygiene and handling are part of daily work on the processing floor, not a line in a brochure.
principles.i4_text: We aim for repeat supply built on consistency rather than one-off deals.

people.title: The team behind the work
people.p1: Buyers deal with real people: the teams on the processing floor, in quality and in the export office.
people.p2: Your first point of contact is the export team, reachable by phone, WhatsApp or email.

direction.title: Vision and mission
direction.vision_text: To be a trusted Egyptian partner in production and supply for regional and international markets, through business built on quality, clarity and lasting relationships.
direction.mission_text: To provide products and supply services that fit the needs of our business partners, connecting production and processing expertise in Egypt with the requirements of the markets we serve.
direction.identity_text: The AZAFCO International identity keeps the AZAFCO name and its heritage, and presents it in a form that matches our ambition to work with international partners and importers.

cta.title: Explore our businesses or start a partnership conversation
cta.intro: For sector cooperation and investment, use the corporate partnership enquiry. It is kept separate from fish supply requests.
